notes.title: For the next update ...
notes.content:
I am grateful to all those users.
The update has been delayed due to some serious problems.

The hard disk of the development PC got broken, so the job data has been deleted.
The date of the last backup data is at the end of July.
So I need to re-create the deleted updates ...
I'll speed it up to update in September.
I am really sorry.

Next update item
  - Shooter function added to Power Fist.
  - Add Stage.
  - Add Escape mission.
  - Add Upgrade item.
  - Added a Special monster.
  - Bug fixes and stabilization.


Oculus is not officially released in Korea, so I have difficulty in obtaining it.
I'll let you know later about the related news.


Thank you!
